$comment: Hacking Growth (Ellis & Brown, 2017) — probes. Fase E2E: sales/akuisisi + after-sales (retensi, aha-moment). Target: DM5.1, DM5.5, R7.2, DS4.2.

probes.text: Pikirkan customer paling setia kamu — momen apa persisnya ketika mereka mulai 'ngerti nilai' produkmu (aha moment)? Dan dari 10 customer baru, berapa kira-kira yang sampai ke momen itu?

signal_interpretation.positive: Aha moment can be described concretely + the majority of new customers reach it — onboarding is healthy
signal_interpretation.negative: Tidak tahu momennya / mayoritas tidak sampai — nilai tidak pernah terasa, churn &口碑 negatif; R7.2 naik
signal_interpretation.neutral: The aha moment is in the founder’s head but isn’t designed into the customer journey — onboarding needs to be mapped

probes.text: What are the most common reasons customers stop/not repeat — have you ever asked those who stopped directly?

signal_interpretation.positive: Have interviewed churned customers + clear pattern of reasons — root cause can be acted upon
signal_interpretation.negative: Tidak pernah tanya / hanya dugaan sendiri — intervensi retensi jadi tebak-tebakan
signal_interpretation.neutral: Know anecdotes but no pattern — need to collect 3-5 churn interviews

probes.text: Dari mana customermu datang sejauh ini — pernah kamu hitung persentase per sumber (referral, iklan, datang sendiri, marketplace, walk-in)?

signal_interpretation.positive: Know the source distribution + at least one active measurable channel — there’s a basis to scale up the channel that works.
signal_interpretation.negative: Tidak tahu sama sekali dari mana customer berasal — acquisition jadi tidak bisa dioptimasi, DS4.2/DM5.1 sulit dibedakan
signal_interpretation.neutral: Rough estimate without numbers — sufficient for initial prioritization, weak for scaling

probes.text: Pernah coba perubahan kecil di cara kamu jualan/onboarding (mis. ganti pesan penawaran, ubah urutan langkah) lalu bandingkan hasilnya dengan cara lama?

signal_interpretation.positive: Pernah eksperimen A/B sederhana (walau informal) — ada budaya iterasi berbasis data
signal_interpretation.negative: Tidak pernah — perubahan besar dilakukan berdasarkan selera/asumsi; C6.3 & channel tidak pernah teruji
signal_interpretation.neutral: Changed before, but without a comparison — the results can’t be learned from.

probes.text: If tomorrow all new customers stopped coming, how long would your business survive on repeat customers right now — and what are you doing this month for those who have already bought?

signal_interpretation.positive: There is real activity for existing customers (communication/reward/upgrade) — the foundation for repeat is there.
signal_interpretation.negative: 100% energi ke customer baru, existing diabaikan setelah transaksi — mahal & rapuh; DM5.5 naik
signal_interpretation.neutral: Niat ada tanpa aktivitas terjadwal — belum menjadi sistem

probes.text: Customer yang puas pernah secara aktif mengarahkan orang lain ke kamu? Berapa kali itu terjadi karena kamu MINTA, dan berapa kali terjadi sendiri?

signal_interpretation.positive: Referral terjadi tanpa diminta berulang kali — nilai terbukti & terlihat, sinyal RAISE terkuat
signal_interpretation.negative: Tidak pernah ada referral organik — klaim 'customer puas' belum terkonfirmasi perilaku pasar
signal_interpretation.neutral: Referral only when requested — value is sufficient but not yet outstanding.
